sources.note: Bare 19th-century wordlist with no pronunciation or accent notes. Forms (mulla 'hand', dilli 'eye', kooda 'nose', munga 'ear') are not initial-dropping, so this list is probably a neighbouring language (Agwamin?) rather than Tagalaka; identity unconfirmed.
